messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for HIGH severity - node gpu-rt-12 failed health checks (kernel-panic). PD incident: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: Pager triggered by kubelet probe failures and host unreachable for gpu-rt-12. Escalation chain initiated.

oncall_sre_lee: acked. I’m on it — grabbing serial console now.

eng_sre_jordan: ack. jumping in for coordination. any immediate customer impact?

oncall_sre_lee: initial glance: node shows KERNEL: "kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception" in journal. kubelet status: NotReady. running `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-rt-12` -> `gpu-rt-12   NotReady   2d   kernelpanic`

platform_robin: saw XID79 in dmesg earlier, possible GPU driver crash followed by host watchdog. pasted last lines below:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=0, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.567891] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```

oncall_sre_lee: plan: cordon -> drain -> kick pods to fallback pool. if drain blocks >2m, force evict with --delete-local-data --force. executing now: `kubectl cordon gpu-rt-12 && kubectl drain gpu-rt-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

oncall_sre_lee: drain started. evicting 12 pods, 3 are stateful (will trigger PV detach). monitoring progress.

kevin: pinging infra autoscaler — do we have spare capacity in dedicated pool to absorb these 12 pods?

platform_robin: autoscaler triggered scale-up to gpu-dedicated-2; adding 2 nodes (requested) to handle steady-state load.

sarah: checking user-facing metrics: small spike in 504s for the last 30s in staging only, prod latency spikes within thresholds. early sign of retries but no customer pages yet. listing services touching this node: model-infer, batch-retrieval, embedding-cache.

incident-bot: Autopager timer: escalation in 5m if still unacked by next tier. Current oncall: oncall_sre_lee (ack).

eng_sre_jordan: running `ssh console@gpu-rt-12` -> connection refused. requesting serial-over-lan (SOL) logs from BMC: `ipmitool -H 10.10.4.12 -U admin -P **** sol activate`

oncall_sre_lee: attached serial excerpt:
```
--- SOL START ---
[   12.345678] watchdog: BUG: soft lockup
[   12.345679] Rebooting in 60 seconds...
--- SOL END ---
```

oncall_sre_lee: node is offline from k8s viewpoint. I’ve created temporary routing rule to move traffic off gpu-rt-12 in the ingress LB. added model variant fallback to cpu-optimized pool for bursty low-priority workloads.

kevin: confirmed autoscaler completed 2 nodes in ~90s, pods are scheduling onto gpu-dedicated-2 and -3. no pending pods now.

sarah: checking customer impact more granularly — wrote quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM errors WHERE node='gpu-rt-12' AND timestamp > now() - 5m` -> 7 errors, all from internal staging jobs. marking impact low.

oncall_sre_lee: leaving handoff note: if node doesn’t come back within 10m, RMA and tag for replacement. Steps left for next oncall:
- verify serial logs in case of repeated XID79
- schedule RMA with partners if hardware fault
- remove node from pool permanently once RMA starts (cordon persists)
- follow up with customer success if any prod customers affected

oncall_sre_robin: ack takeover in 25m. I’ll monitor the RMA ticket and confirm final remediation. please DM me if it becomes urgent before handoff.

eng_sre_jordan: one more note — we should block scheduling onto gpu-rt-12 via a taint until RMA done: `kubectl taint node gpu-rt-12 hardware=faulty:NoSchedule`

oncall_sre_lee: applied taint. leaving pod eviction logs and node annotate: `annotate: rma=opened PD12345`

incident-bot: Pager cleared (auto) - node removed from cluster and pod reschedule completed. PD incident PD12345 transitioned to MONITOR. Followup: RMA ticket RMA-9876 opened.

oncall_sre_robin: picked up handoff. I’ll verify RMA progress and close PD once hw swap confirmed. thanks for the fast coord everyone :thumbsup:
